notes: Legacy n is named stellar_mass_normalization_legacy; it is not a Sersic index.
Legacy Einstein radius, M200 and source centres are preserved without claiming validation.
The adopted stellar_mass_normalization is preferred to its unchanged _legacy predecessor for new preparation.
Stellar M/L uses real stars, intrinsic SDSS i, native StellarHsml and a circular YZ aperture at the new selection YZ radius. Dark matter, gas and wind masses are excluded from this numerator.
Solar i absolute magnitude 4.53 is used consistently for luminosity and the template conversion; old mixed 4.53/4.52 calibration remains only in legacy values.
Selection radii do not replace inherited mock Einstein radii, source coordinates, fitting masks or position constraints. Existing mocks and fits are not regenerated by this parameter update.
